assertions.name: remote_trace_probe_reaches_guest_terminal
assertions.expected: The trace-enabled short probe publishes a serial terminal marker and result.json before the host bound
assertions.actual: The QEMU launch remained running when the fixed-lifetime Docker container exited with code 0; serial and result artifacts were never published

next_boundary: Fresh long-lived host container is required before one trace-enabled short probe; do not interpret stale lifecycle as guest evidence
